report.causal_tests:
Exactly 30 distinct nonzero candidates received full-development evaluation. The full ledger, including all controls and failed protection checks, is /work/final_30_round_research_summary.json; manifests are in /work/final_30_candidate_manifest_audit.json.
Early layer-26 MLP direction edits were behaviorally almost null. Layer-10 attention-output edits produced some development gains, but random-direction and matched-channel controls could also repair the focal Camera/Ring example. Head-7 component tests failed their focal sufficiency predictions. These results did not establish attention-direction or head specificity.
At MLP layer 15, round 17 removed the nominated parallel component but retained the baseline repair_score and had zero net counterfactual-visual gain. Full selected-channel ablation in round 20 and removal of the orthogonal component in round 22 both reached repair_score 0.35546875. Round 22 preserved the originally nominated direction and retained all nine fixed reference counterfactual-visual repairs, with net +4 in that condition. Thus the nominated parallel component was not necessary for that observed repair pattern. The half-dose orthogonal edit retained four of nine reference repairs, failing its prediction of at least five. Opposite-sign augmentation retained zero of nine and had net -1 counterfactual-visual correctness, consistent with its registered negative-control prediction.
Round 25 replaced the small retained output direction with a randomized direction while keeping the near-ablation construction: it retained all nine reference repairs and net +4 counterfactual-visual correctness. This weakens an interpretation requiring the retained direction's orientation. Round 26 applied the same projector to a fixed disjoint matched 64-channel set, with perturbation norm ratio about 0.9966 relative to round 22. It retained two of nine reference repairs but also had net +4 counterfactual-visual correctness, while harming counterfactual-usual performance and failing cell protection. Aggregate visual gains were therefore not unique to the originally selected channels.
The final decomposition predictions were recorded before rounds 27-30. The three channels accounting for 51.43% of summed individual write energy retained only four of nine reference repairs and had net -1 counterfactual-visual correctness, failing the predicted sufficiency criterion. Their 61-channel complement, round 28, retained six of nine and had net +10, contradicting the prediction of fewer than six and becoming the harness-selected best. The two edits form an exact disjoint effective-weight partition of round 22, but their behavioral effects need not add.
The rank-one common-input component in round 29 retained only two of nine repairs and net -1 counterfactual-visual correctness, failing its sufficiency prediction. The residual-input component in round 30 retained seven of nine and net +6, contradicting the prediction of fewer than six; it also failed cell protection. This occurred despite the common mean direction capturing about 96.56% of input squared magnitude and the residual accounting for only about 3.49% of raw write energy on the 96 measured last-prompt inputs. All four final decomposition predictions failed. These native-dose components were not norm-matched, individual channel energy omitted interference terms, and last-prompt measurements do not characterize edits applied at every token.
report.counterevidence:
Reproducibility remains unresolved. For round 28, fresh generation matched the official cached sequence on six of seven selected requests. C-125:counterfact_visual:T1:O1:B0 was cached as Ring but freshly generated Camera, so that registered focal repair did not reproduce. C-288:counterfact_visual:T1:O0:B0 reproduced Fish->Nail, and C-455:counterfact_visual:T1:O0:B0 remained Lime, reproducing avoidance of a round-22 damage. The combined registered answer-verification criterion therefore failed. The seven W0 and round-22 normalization-probe sequences did match their caches, but that does not resolve the round-28 discrepancy.
Earlier audits also found cache/fresh disagreements: seven of sixteen W0 sequences differed, with the fresh W0 sequences repeating exactly in a subsequent diagnostic run; another selected audit had nine of 56 W0 mismatches and four of 56 round-20 mismatches. Identical recorded prompt hashes do not explain these execution-path discrepancies. Their cause is unknown. Official baseline grading and selection were not replaced by diagnostic outcomes.
All seven official round-28 damages are retained: C-588:counterfact_usual:T0:O0:B0 Skunk->Grasshopper; C-617:no_image_usual:T1:O1:B0 Stork->Cheeseburger; C-606:counterfact_usual:T0:O0:B1 Pool table->Squash; C-348:no_image_usual:T1:O1:B0 Truck->Honeycomb; C-227:no_image_usual:T0:O0:B0 Dog->Lens cap; C-227:original_visual:T1:O1:B1 Dog->Lens cap; C-293:no_image_usual:T0:O0:B0 Football->Cockroach. Improvement is not uniform across five-way prompt variants. The selected candidate's largest protected-cell loss is 2/64=0.03125, below the 0.035 limit; it has nine format errors and zero truncations. Passing these limits does not mean zero collateral harm.
report.failure_behavior: On some counterfactual-visual size questions, the baseline answers according to usual object size rather than depicted size. The failures are heterogeneous: prompt scope, object order, usual-size knowledge and naming also affect performance. The selected candidate is round 28, not the last candidate. Its official development accuracy is 2041/2560 (0.797265625), versus W0's 2026/2560 (0.79140625): 22 repairs, seven damages, net +15 correct. The harness repair_score increases from 0.33984375 to 0.36328125; primary_joint increases separately from 0.296875 to 0.3125. Correct counts out of 512 per condition change as follows: no_image_usual 416->415, original_usual 466->468, counterfact_usual 312->315, original_visual 491->492, counterfact_visual 341->351. Counterfactual-visual has ten official repairs and no official damages, but this is a selected development result, not a generalization estimate.
report.internal_evidence:
Construction: independently reconstruct from W0 and modify only language_model.model.layers.15.mlp.down_proj.weight, shape [2560,10240]. Round 28 applies the exact effective BF16 round-22 edit to the complementary 61 of its original 64 selected columns; channels 9541, 2486 and 5848 are restored to W0, as are all other weights. On edited columns the construction retains u(u^T W0_column), removing the component orthogonal to u, subject to BF16 rounding. The manifest records 156137 changed scalars and L2 2.0688491019040995. The absolute columns are saved in /work/r28_mlp15_energy_complement_edit.npz and the original direction/channel plan in /work/mlp_L15_projection_plan.npz.
The original 64-channel selection was supervised. Last-prompt measurements on 96 diagnostic inputs included controlled contrasts subtracting original-visual and counterfactual-usual differences from counterfactual-visual success/failure differences. The layer-15 direction had mean leave-one-group-out cosine about 0.532, but projected writes separated failures and successes only weakly. These are localization associations, not evidence for a unique size circuit.
Direct verification of round 28 used seven previously selected requests with identical prompt hashes and exactly equal layer-15 MLP inputs across W0 and the candidate. Predicted delta-W times activation matched the measured pre-normalization write change: cosine 0.9997279 to 0.9998817, relative error approximately 1.54%-2.34%, and measured raw delta norm 0.35070-0.38243. Post-feedforward normalization output delta norms were 152.04-184.29, corresponding to delta gains of 432.13-494.79. Layer-output changes were not identical to normalization-output changes. These measurements verify application and local propagation of the weight perturbation; they do not establish which change mediates an answer or that normalization is the semantic mechanism. Sources: turns 0011, 0013, 0125, 0139 and 0140; /work/r28_direct_mechanism_audit.json.
report.scope:
The study is limited to this Gemma-3-4b-it branch-C development set: 64 source groups, five conditions and eight prompt variants, totaling 2560 requests. The variants are not 2560 independent source examples. All 30 candidates have distinct effective tensor signatures, nonzero edits and support below the final one-million-scalar limit. Turn 0146 verified identical ordered request IDs, all 2560 input/rendered-chat/token-type hash triplets, and evaluation protocols against W0 for every candidate. This consistency audit does not establish numerical reproducibility across execution paths.
The development data were repeatedly inspected and adaptively reused. Channel selection was supervised, reference repair identities were outcome-selected, and diagnostic audits used previously seen requests. There is no independent efficacy estimate, held-out confirmation, multiple-comparison-adjusted significance claim, or established uniquely size-specific causal circuit. Single randomized controls do not supply a randomization distribution. Local write measurements and failed decomposition predictions narrow the account but leave mechanism identification incomplete.
Final evaluation receipts record 79890 forwards/samples, 21090336 actual target tokens and 16373760 actual visual tokens; 337455360 reserved target tokens are a different accounting quantity. Researcher usage for failed turn 0099 is unknown because no usage receipt was recovered. The search stopped at 30 candidates; no round 31 or further model evaluation was performed. Final evidence and all round summaries are saved in /work/final_30_round_research_summary.json.
report.verdict: Select round 28, candidate c-58e249de16eeca1aa958e979e07beb5a6423db5cd815a3de9c37fa757730a4d1, as the actual harness-selected best for freeze. It yields a modest official development improvement with seven collateral errors and satisfies the stated protection limits. The strongest supported mechanistic observation is that these static MLP15 column edits produce the predicted local write changes and substantial downstream normalization changes. The evidence does not validate the original semantic-direction hypothesis, high-energy-channel sufficiency, or common-input sufficiency. A focal repair failed fresh reproduction. Mechanism identification and reproducible generalization remain unproven.
